items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Bill Matthews? Well, I heard Bill a couple of times play drum on the street.

ctx.x: Well, they had some little extra things at those wake. Well, they had some little extra things at those wake. I don't want to put you on the spot. I'd ask you to get back. They had little extra things at those wakes. They don't have an ordinary wake.

Well, I wouldn't say it, Bill. I mean, Dick. Yeah. Yeah, I mean, usually at house wakes, they always have that little coffee, little wine drinking like. Yeah. Well, that's about the same they had over there. Had the same thing.
Yeah. So, uh, well, anyway, you played both those funerals. Yeah, I played both of them. What bands were there?
